root_problem: business users cannot complete a request when ownership, required information, and approval outcome are unclear
business_goals: define an end-to-end business request flow with explicit approval outcomes
acceptance_criteria: Given a complete request, when an authorized reviewer approves it, then the requester sees the approved outcome and next action
design_decisions: Design must decide how request state transitions are represented without changing confirmed business outcomes
scope_boundaries: include one request submission path, reviewer decision path, and requester status visibility

delivery_plan.goal: deliver the first closed-loop request review flow

locked_fields.root_problem: business users cannot complete a request when ownership, required information, and approval outcome are unclear

user_profile.scenario: a submitted request needs a clear decision and visible outcome
user_profile.current_workaround: coordinate status and missing information outside the product flow

business_goals: define an end-to-end business request flow with explicit approval outcomes

appetite.complexity_ceiling: support one clear request review flow before broad automation
appetite.trim_first: advanced routing, analytics, and visual polish

scope_boundaries: include one request submission path, reviewer decision path, and requester status visibility
non_goals: do not automate every review policy or redesign unrelated workflows

feasibility_constraints.constraint: Director-owned scope and approval outcomes remain fixed during PM refinement
feasibility_constraints.impact_scope: request submission, review decision, and status visibility
feasibility_constraints.handling: map each rule to UNIT, AC, and Verification Plan without adding technical implementation paths

risks_and_unknowns.item: approval edge cases may be under-specified
risks_and_unknowns.impact: UNIT boundaries and AC could miss important review outcomes
risks_and_unknowns.mitigation: confirm normal, boundary, and failure examples before delivery

decision_rationale.decision: focus on one closed-loop request review flow
decision_rationale.choice: define clear inputs, decision behavior, observable outcomes, and exclusions
decision_rationale.rationale: downstream design needs stable business behavior before technical options are evaluated
decision_rationale.excluded_options: broad policy automation or implementation-first planning
